notes: Variant WLC.JOB.38.1.v001 is underdetermined and the base projection is compatible with the ASV; no textual decision made here (rule 9).
`אֵת` is its own `unrepresented` unit, the ordinary ruling of rule 16: the ASV writes *answered Job* with the object bare and spends no word on the object relation.
`מִן` → *out of* is headed on *out*, the word carrying the ablative lexeme (rule 24).
